benchmark_comparison.note: Reference comparators only. All risk/return statistics above use completed daily net paths with 252-day annualization on the same F2R support; F2R is not managed as a benchmark-relative mandate.

completed_performance.performance_note: Completed current-model performance through 2026-08-31 only. Cumulative wealth and drawdown use the daily completed net path. Current MTD is shown separately and is not included in these charts, tables, or completed-history risk statistics.

evidence_boundary.public_disclosure: Historical results reflect the current governed F2R specification applied consistently over the available historical support.
evidence_boundary.research_label: Related research and prior model versions remain separate evidence.

historical_targets.history_note: Exact target lineage for the displayed completed cumulative-performance path through 2026-08-31. Signal 2026-08 / holding 2026-09 belongs to Current MTD and is intentionally excluded here; Preview is also excluded.

current_mtd.state_note: Current-model return for the open holding month; separate from completed performance.
